title: Rules.
bodyText: The director shall adopt rules necessary to carry out the purposes of this part, including the establishment of criteria to determine eligibility to participate in the services provided under this part.
bodyHtml: [§321-326]  Rules.  The director shall adopt rules necessary to carry out the purposes of this part, including the establishment of criteria to determine eligibility to participate in the services provided under this part. [L 1988, c 203, pt of §1]
